event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
parties: UAE 43 - Ivana and Alex - Chavdar Aleksandrov
procedural_matters: BEL 1450 was represented by Hugo Henrique (helm).
UAE 43 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
Finn Mrugalla (member of the International Jury) provided video evidence of the incident and gave evidence as a witness.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: BEL 1450 is 45 ft long and UAE 43 is 43 ft long.
The conditions at the time of the incident during race 1 for ORC A were 12 knots of wind and small chop.
BEL 1450 was sailing with her sails slightly eased on starboard tack above the layline to mark 1a when she entered the zone of the mark.
UAE 43 was sailing close-hauled on port tack, 0.5 boat lengths below the port layline, and on collision course with BEL 1450.
When UAE 43 was approximately 0.5 boat lengths from mark 1a, she luffed and passed head to wind to starboard tack.
At this time, BEL 1450 was 0.5 boat lengths away from UAE 43 and her bow was aiming at the front quarter of UAE 43's hull. BEL 1450 luffed to a close-hauled course.
When UAE 43 reached a close-hauled course on starboard tack, she was overlapped to leeward of BEL 1450 and the distance between her stern and BEL 1450's bow was 2 m.
Both boats bore away almost simultaneously around mark 1a.
conclusions: Before passing head to wind from port to starboard tack, UAE 43 on port tack kept clear of BEL 1450 on starboard tack, as required by RRS 10.
After passing head to wind and before being on a close-hauled course, UAE 43 failed to keep clear of BEL 1450. UAE 43 broke RRS 13.
